// MATLAB R2022a Update1 / MATPOWER7.1 MIPS, tolerance1e-9.
options=optimoptions(`fmincon`,`MaxIterations`,300,`OptimalityTolerance`,1e-9,`ConstraintTolerance`,1e-9,
    `bound_relax_factor`,0,`acceptable_iter`,0,`mu_strategy`,`adaptive`);
result=runopf_case(baseMVA,bus,gen,branch,gencost,options);
rb=getfield(result,`bus`); rg=getfield(result,`gen`); rl=getfield(result,`branch`);
f=getfield(result,`f`); success=getfield(result,`success`); flag=getfield(result,`exitflag`);
output=getfield(result,`output`); violation=getfield(output,`constraint_violation`); iterations=getfield(output,`iterations`);
assert_eq(success,1);
assert_abs_diff_eq(f,576.8923368621812,0.001);
